title: Category and brand search
subtitle: A word for a kind of place, or a brand, is searched inside a circle: 10 km, widened once to 25 km, never beyond. Nothing from outside the circle is added. Every provider call spends the limits (P011f1, ADR 0018)

nodes.label: App: POST /v1/search with q, or category, and a coarse point in the body
Classify q with the dictionary (intents.json): whole words only, no fuzzy match. category sent by the app wins
NAME (anything else, e.g. Bankura): the name search as before, local-first
Place hint ("sbi exampletown"): look it up once, charged; its point rounded to 2 decimals becomes the centre. Unknown hint: name search
No point and no hint: no circle. Name search among places only, so a town is not an answer
Charge the limits, then places of the category within SEARCH_CATEGORY_RADIUS_KM (10). Brand: 20 candidates, keep those with the brand's name
Only with fewer than SEARCH_MIN_LOCAL_RESULTS (3) in the circle: charge the limits again, then ONE wider circle of 25 km. Never beyond, and no name search
Provider. Geoapify Places API: categories + filter=circle, one credit up to 20 places. A provider without it: the word by name inside the circle
Sort by distance, drop anything outside the circle, cut to limit. An EMPTY list is a valid answer
200: results with matchType and distanceMeters, searchedRadiusKm (10 or 25), searchedAround, attribution
ONE LOG LINE: outcome, match_type, latency, counts, searched_radius_km. Never the text, the category, a coordinate or a result
429 or 503 + Retry-After when a limit refuses a needed call. A refused or failed widening keeps the first circle's places

edges.label: centre: hint or the app's point
